summary: Tested the reported AvailabilityPicker crash in the browser at 390x844. FIXED: /hire/register (passenger@travoo.in) renders with no ErrorBoundary or 'reading length' error. Add Availability on that screen works: date picker, end-before-start check, overlap check, add, edit (fields pre-filled, 'Edit Availability' title) and delete, with no pageerrors. DocPhotos shows Driving licence front, back and Aadhaar card tiles. The old 'Aadhaar Card (Front)' card is gone. Aadhaar upload via gallery -> preview -> upload sent POST /api/driver/documents/id_proof 200, the tile turned green, and there was no crash. The test file was then deleted (DELETE 200). Quick regression of /, /offer, /bookings, /messages, /notifications, /profile, /more, /hire and /hire/driver all OK. FOUND 2 BUGS on the approved driver dashboard Availability tab (/hire/driver): (1) saving always fails with a 'Nothing to update' toast (PUT /api/pro/settings 400), so nothing persists; (2) schedules saved at registration show as '12:00 AM - 12:00 AM' and have no id. ENV ISSUE FIXED: pyarrow was missing, so the LGD import failed silently, /api/lgd/states returned [] and the Home location picker was empty. Installed pyarrow==26.0.1 and the LGD data then loaded.

critical.issue: ProSettingsIn (server.py ~line 3075) has no 'availability' field. The dashboard sends {availability:[...]}, Pydantic drops the unknown key, upd is empty and the API returns 400 'Nothing to update'. Dashboard Availability add/edit/delete never persists. Add availability: Optional[List[...]] (date, from, to), validate and normalise it like /pro/register, and store it with ids.

minor.issue: Stored availability records have no 'id', and from/to are full ISO strings ('2026-12-04T09:00:00+05:30') instead of the 'HH:MM' that AvailabilityPicker expects. The client 'id' is dropped.

ui_bugs.issue: Schedules saved at registration show '12:00 AM - 12:00 AM'. formatTime splits the ISO string, gets NaN for the hour, and NaN%12||12 gives 12. The card testID is 'avail-schedule-undefined', and React warns 'Each child in a list should have a unique key' (red dev toast). Because handleDeleteSchedule filters with s.id !== undefined, deleting one id-less record removes ALL id-less records. Edit puts the ISO string into the From/To fields.

integration_issues.issue: onSave -> save('availability', {availability}) -> PUT /pro/settings returns 400 'Nothing to update'. The card shows locally but is lost on reload.

issues: Label above AvailabilityPicker says 'Available days' (t('v2.availability')), but the picker is date-specific. Consider 'Availability dates'.

action_items: Backend: add 'availability' to ProSettingsIn and handle it in PUT /pro/settings (validate date/from/to, store with id).

Store a consistent availability shape in both /pro/register and /pro/settings: {id, date, from:'HH:MM', to:'HH:MM'}, or convert to and from ISO on load in hire/driver.tsx. Generate an id server-side when it is missing.
In hire/driver.tsx load(), map p.availability to {id: a.id ?? `${a.date}-${i}`, date, from: a.from.slice(11,16) if ISO, to: ...} so existing records show correct times and have unique keys/ids.
Environment: pyarrow (in requirements.txt) was not installed in this fork, which broke the LGD import silently. Consider logging exceptions from the lgd_import background task.
critical_code_review_comments: register.tsx still keeps the aadhaarFront state, set from the id_proof file, and sends aadhaar_front in the body. That is harmless, but it duplicates the id_proof document.
AvailabilityPicker formatDate uses new Date('YYYY-MM-DD'), which is parsed as UTC. In timezones west of UTC it can show the previous day.
AvailabilityPicker From/To are free-text Fields with no HH:MM format check. Input like '9' or 'ab' gives NaN, which passes validateTimeRange as false and shows a confusing message.
The lgd_import asyncio task swallows exceptions (no done-callback logging). That is why the missing pyarrow went unnoticed.
updated_files: env: pip install pyarrow==26.0.1 + backend restart

success_rate.frontend: 80% (register-screen crash fix, availability CRUD on register, Aadhaar upload and regression pass; dashboard Availability save fails)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Avail19 (test_avail19_c2a1ee@example.com) as an approved pro driver for the dashboard test. Deleted afterwards by user_id (users, pro_drivers, driver_documents). The Aadhaar test upload on passenger@travoo.in was deleted through the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Language screen appears first: click language-continue-button, then auth-toggle-mode for email login. Dashboard tab testIDs are dash-tab-availability etc. To get an approved driver, run backend/tests/ui_setup_iter19_avail.py; it uses a direct DB update for approval because the admin password is unknown. Writing files under /app/backend triggers a backend hot reload, which restarts the LGD import. The browser clock is Nov 2026, so calendar day testIDs are avail-date-day-2026-11-DD.
rca of the issue: Original crash: register.tsx passed value= but AvailabilityPicker reads availability, so availability was undefined and availability.length threw. Fixed by passing availability= and defaulting the prop to []. Verified. New dashboard bug: the backend /pro/settings model has no availability field (400), and the shape stored by /pro/register is incompatible with the picker (ISO times, no id).
